title: Anthropic's Claude 3.7 Sonnet Introduces Extended Thinking
subtitle: The new model displays its step-by-step reasoning process in full, sets a new record on software engineering benchmarks, and marks a significant shift in how AI assistants approach complex problems.
author: Editorial Team
meta_description: Claude 3.7 Sonnet, released February 24, 2025, introduces extended thinking — a visible chain-of-thought reasoning mode that achieves 62.3% on SWE-bench Verified and 97.6% on HumanEval, making it Anthropic's most capable model to date.

title: DeepSeek-R1 Matches GPT-4o at 5% of the Cost
subtitle: The Chinese lab's open-weight reasoning model triggered a global AI hardware rethink — and wiped $590 billion from Nvidia's market cap in a single trading session.
author: Editorial Team
meta_description: DeepSeek-R1 is a 671 billion parameter open-weight reasoning model that matches GPT-4o on major benchmarks while costing a fraction to train — upending assumptions about AI development costs.

title: SpaceX Catches the Starship Booster Mid-Air with Mechazilla
subtitle: On October 13, 2024, a 71-metre rocket booster returned from space and was caught by mechanical arms on the launch tower — a first in the history of rocketry.
author: Editorial Team
meta_description: SpaceX completed Integrated Flight Test 5 on October 13, 2024, catching the Super Heavy booster with Mechazilla's mechanical arms — the first time a booster of this scale has been caught rather than landed.
